effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For each of your Digimon with the [Deva] or [Four Sovereigns] trait, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, during your opponent's next unsuspend phase, all of their Digimon can't unsuspend.
[On Deletion] Delete 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
